heroSummary: Katy ISD's 172 instructional days include enough operational minutes to cover two bad-weather days. Campus Professional Learning Days create student-free dates in September, October, November, February, and immediately before Spring Break.
sourceCalendarName: Katy Independent School District 2027–28 Instructional Calendar PDF
sourceReviewSummary: We checked the dates and district terminology against Katy ISD's approved 2027–28 instructional calendar. We also reviewed the district's January 20, 2026 calendar-adoption announcement.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: What we checked in the official sources
sourceReviewDetails: On August 10, 2026, the official Katy ISD calendar link returned the approved 2027–28 PDF. Source file checksum (SHA-256): 90517fbe…f34daa09.
The official calendar lists January 3 as a Campus Day with no students, January 4 as the first day of the spring semester, and March 10 as a Campus Professional Learning Day with no students.
The calendar lists 81 instructional days in the fall and 91 in the spring, for 172 total. It also states that sufficient minutes are included to cover two bad-weather days.
Official event terminology is preserved where practical. Familiar break labels are used when they make an official holiday range easier for families to identify.
sourceNextReviewText: Next review: when Katy ISD revises the 2027–28 instructional calendar or changes the official resource linked from its calendar page.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for Katy ISD in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Wednesday, August 11, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Katy ISD Fall Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Katy ISD Fall Break runs Friday, October 8 through Tuesday, October 12, 2027. Classes resume Wednesday, October 13.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Katy ISD Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20 through December 31, 2027. January 3 is a Campus Day with no students, so classes resume Tuesday, January 4, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Katy ISD Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Katy ISD Spring Break runs Monday, March 13 through Friday, March 17, 2028. March 10 is a Campus Professional Learning Day with no students, and classes resume Monday, March 20.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Katy ISD in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 24, 2028, with early dismissal.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the Katy ISD calendar, and how many bad-weather days does it cover?
calendarFaqs.a: Katy ISD has 172 instructional days in 2027–28: 81 in the fall semester and 91 in the spring. The district calendar says it contains enough operational minutes to cover two bad-weather days.

calendarNotes: Katy ISD's approved 2027–28 instructional calendar starts August 11, 2027 and ends with early dismissal on May 24, 2028. Fall Break runs October 8–12, Spring Break runs March 13–17, and March 10 is a Campus Professional Learning Day with no students. The calendar lists 172 instructional days and includes enough operational minutes to cover two bad-weather days. Official event terminology is preserved where practical, familiar break labels are used for clarity, and derived return dates are identified by their descriptions and placement in the date table.
